description: Two-Cell's flashlight: a scuffed, rubber-armoured brick of a torch with "2-CELL" gouged into the barrel by a man who names his tools. The lens is cracked clean across and could not possibly care less. Grady swears it has never once left him in the dark: not through two floods, one roof collapse, and a marriage. Best of all, it sips power like a monk sips wine. A single cell lasts it about twice as long as any shop-bought light. LIGHT it on, UNLIGHT to save the cell, RELOAD when it finally dies (which it won't, mostly out of spite).
